name: io.github.xallindrome-labs/codex-bridge
title: codex-bridge
description: Claude Code consults Codex for plans, images and optional code, as durable background jobs.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Codex CLI binary. Auto-detected when unset.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BRIDGE_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where job files are stored. Default: ~/.codex-bridge

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BRIDGE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Stop a run after this many ms with no Codex output. Default: 600000

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BRIDGE_PLAN_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model for codex_plan. Default: your Codex config.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BRIDGE_PLAN_EFFORT
environmentVariables.description: Reasoning effort for codex_plan. Default: your Codex config.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BRIDGE_IMAGE_EFFORT
environmentVariables.description: Reasoning effort for codex_image. Default: high

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BRIDGE_WRITE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in. One folder Codex may edit through the codex_code tool. Unset = codex_code is off.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BRIDGE_WRITE_ALLOW_TMP
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to stop asking Codex to block temp-folder writes in codex_code. Default: unset.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BRIDGE_CODE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model for codex_code. Default: your Codex config.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BRIDGE_CODE_EFFORT
environmentVariables.description: Reasoning effort for codex_code. Default: your Codex config.
